title: Hospital-Day Reversals in a Settled Coinsurance Block — Medicare Part A Bank Drafts
content:
**Medicare Part A Skilled Nursing Facility Coverage — hospital days and the bank draft.** A day reversed as a hospital day is not a covered day: when the settled block's booked-days entry carries a hospital-day reversal, its reversed days inside the settled block come off the days the bank draft counts before the supplemental effective date, all of them when its last reversed day falls before that date, those from its first reversed day up to the day before the date when the date falls after its first reversed day and on or before its last, and none otherwise; without such a reversal, none come off.

### Basis Q&A

**What record is read?** A reversal of booked days with the reason hospital day, posted against the settled block's own booked-days entry; its span runs from its first to its last reversed day.

**How many days come off when the supplemental effective date falls inside the span?** The days from the first reversed day up to the day before the date.

**And when the date falls after the span, or before it?** After the last reversed day, every reversed day inside the settled block; on or before the first, none.

*Hypothetical worked example:* a hospital-day reversal covers the 17th to the 19th. With a supplemental effective date of the 18th, one day (the 17th) comes off; with the 20th, three days; with the 16th, none.
